requirement:
修复车次信息查询服务的 bug。
车次信息服务在查询经停车次时返回空数据。
需要检查车次信息与旅行服务之间的数据查询逻辑。

details.name: ts-travel-service
details.rationale: The requirement mentions checking data query logic between ticket info and travel services; ts-travel-service is the primary travel service that likely provides train/trip data.

details.name: ts-travel2-service
details.rationale: ts-travel2-service is another travel-related service that may be involved in querying stop information for trains.

details.name: ts-route-service
details.rationale: Route service may provide route and stop data that ticket info queries depend on.

details.name: ts-route-plan-service
details.rationale: Route plan service could be involved in planning or querying stops for a trip.

details.name: ts-train-service
details.rationale: Train service holds train information that may be used to determine stops.

details.name: ts-station-service
details.rationale: Station service may provide station data used in stop queries.
